# Attorney Brian White & Associates

> Houston-based personal injury law firm providing comprehensive legal representation across multiple practice areas with 45+ years of combined attorney experience.

Attorney Brian White & Associates specializes in personal injury litigation throughout Houston and Texas, offering board-certified representation for car accidents, brain injuries, wrongful death, workplace injuries, maritime claims, and product liability cases. The firm serves the Harris County area including Upper Kirby/Greenway and maintains a strong track record of client testimonials and community involvement.
